intro.vo: Managing your stock. Four simple steps.

beats.caption: Hatua 1: Fungua Hifadhi kutoka Menyu
beats.vo: Step one. Open the menu and tap stock levels.

beats.caption: Hatua 2: Angalia bidhaa zinazopungua
beats.vo: Step two. Open the low stock tab to see what is running out.

beats.caption: Hatua 3: Chagua bidhaa na uongeze hifadhi
beats.vo: Step three. Tap a product, enter how many arrived, and save the adjustment.

beats.caption: Hatua 4: Hakiki hifadhi mpya
beats.vo: Step four. Check the list. Your new stock is there.

endCard.title: Sasampa POS
endCard.subtitle: Tazama mafunzo mengine.
endCard.vo: That is all. Watch our other tutorials to learn more.
